reconciliation.note: Schema 2 removed the obsolete classicInertMoraleThresholds marker and split mixed rows into independently owned leaf diagnostics. Schema 3 also records source-backed item categories, restrictions, combat fields, stored spells, equipped conditions, and special-ability modifiers, including the dependent monster-item rows those implementations resolve.

classic-synchronous-sound.requiredEvidence: A source action with a negative sound ID and a runtime test proving that script execution waits for playback completion.
classic-synchronous-sound.notes: Informational source behavior, not a fidelity fallback.

inactive-custom-spell-definition.requiredEvidence: A source-backed consumer reference or reachable runtime route for the preserved custom spell definition.
inactive-custom-spell-definition.notes: Definitions remain preserved until an active consumer is proven.

inactive-macro-target.requiredEvidence: A reachable source call path proving that the unmarked Data ED3 target is callable in Classic.
inactive-macro-target.notes: The producer preserves the reference without making unreachable code callable.

inactive-scenario-rule-table.requiredEvidence: Classic load-profile control flow showing whether the scenario-local race or caste table replaces the selected shared table.
inactive-scenario-rule-table.notes: The shared rule table remains authoritative for these campaigns.

invalid-complex-spell-failure-sentinel.requiredEvidence: Classic selection-range evidence and a fixture showing that the invalid spell ID resolves to the default failure result.
invalid-complex-spell-failure-sentinel.notes: The preserved invalid sentinel already matches the observed Classic failure path.

invalid-scenario-spell-item-fallback.requiredEvidence: The packed Data NI field layout, the original item record, and a Classic use or inspection comparison for each impossible spell ID.
invalid-scenario-spell-item-fallback.notes: The item is preserved but deliberately inert until its packed identity is explained.

missing-macro-target.requiredEvidence: The originating source record, bounds behavior for the missing Data ED3 index, and a Classic gameplay or debugger observation at the call site.
missing-macro-target.notes: Remake currently uses a deterministic no-op instead of emulating an undefined record read.

missing-message.requiredEvidence: The source action, the complete message-table inventory, and a Classic comparison showing whether the reference is silent, invalid, or supplied externally.
missing-message.notes: The missing text affects presentation unless source control flow proves a behavioral dependency.

classic-item-category-fallback.requiredEvidence: Classic canuse category scanning, an imported item fixture, and equip/use tests covering the exact category bit.
classic-item-category-fallback.notes: The item is identifiable but its first active Classic permission category lacks an exact native projection.

classic-item-combat-field-fallback.requiredEvidence: Classic item combat source, exact imported records, and equipment/combat tests for the reported damage, armor, or weapon field.
classic-item-combat-field-fallback.notes: A source combat field is retained but not yet applied through exact Classic rules.

classic-item-field-fallback.requiredEvidence: Per-field Classic source semantics, an imported item fixture, and a focused test at every runtime consumer.
classic-item-field-fallback.notes: Catch-all for a materialized item field that needs a dedicated leaf family before implementation.

classic-item-restriction-fallback.requiredEvidence: Classic canuse restriction control flow, exact race/caste records, and equip/use denial tests.
classic-item-restriction-fallback.notes: The source restriction bits exceed or disagree with the current native permission projection.

classic-item-special-effect-fallback.requiredEvidence: Classic item special-field dispatch, exact imported records, and identification/use/equip/combat tests for each special field.
classic-item-special-effect-fallback.notes: One or more scripted or cursed item effects remain preserved without exact runtime behavior.

classic-monster-active-weapon-projection.requiredEvidence: Classic monster inventory and loot source plus a battle fixture proving active weapon use and post-battle drops.
classic-monster-active-weapon-projection.notes: Classic stores an active weapon separately from its carried slots; the native projection must preserve both use and loot semantics.

classic-monster-attack-sound-fallback.requiredEvidence: Classic attack-sound selection source, exact attack rows, and an audible combat presentation test.
classic-monster-attack-sound-fallback.notes: The attack remains functional but currently uses a generic sound.

classic-monster-elemental-mitigation-fal.requiredEvidence: Classic elemental special-attack source and deterministic save/protection/damage fixtures for party and monster targets.
classic-monster-elemental-mitigation-fal.notes: Native resistance currently replaces Classic's separate save and protection sequence.

classic-monster-field-fallback.requiredEvidence: Per-field Classic source semantics, an exact monster fixture, and a focused combat test.
classic-monster-field-fallback.notes: Catch-all for a monster field that needs a dedicated leaf family before implementation.

classic-monster-item-detection-fallback.requiredEvidence: Classic detected-item sign-bit source and inventory/loot inspection tests that preserve identification state.
classic-monster-item-detection-fallback.notes: The item can be carried and dropped, but the source magic-detected marker is lost.

classic-monster-item-materialization-fal.requiredEvidence: Resolution of the referenced item leaf diagnostics plus monster inventory, equipment, and loot tests.
classic-monster-item-materialization-fal.notes: A monster inventory slot references an item whose own Classic fields are not fully materialized.

classic-monster-missile-item-fallback.requiredEvidence: Classic monster missile-selection source and deterministic item, charge, chance, and targeting tests.
classic-monster-missile-item-fallback.notes: The source missile chance cannot be executed with an exact carried missile item.

classic-monster-non-equippable-weapon-fa.requiredEvidence: Classic weapon-use source and a fixture proving how the active item behaves when its native category is not equippable.
classic-monster-non-equippable-weapon-fa.notes: The source active weapon is carried but cannot be represented as native equipment.

classic-monster-random-weapon-fallback.requiredEvidence: Classic negative weapon selector source, exact candidate records, and seeded selection/equipment/loot tests.
classic-monster-random-weapon-fallback.notes: The source random active-weapon selector is preserved but not executed.

classic-monster-special-attack-fallback.requiredEvidence: Classic attack special dispatch, an exact attack-row fixture, and deterministic save/effect tests for each reported special code.
classic-monster-special-attack-fallback.notes: The attack identity is retained but the special effect is not fully handled.

classic-monster-weapon-materialization-f.requiredEvidence: Resolution of the referenced item leaf diagnostics plus active weapon and loot tests.
classic-monster-weapon-materialization-f.notes: The active weapon references an item whose own Classic fields are not fully materialized.

classic-monster-weapon-requirement-feedb.requiredEvidence: Classic required-weapon hit checks and exact failure-result presentation for blunt, sharp, item-ID, and magic-plus requirements.
classic-monster-weapon-requirement-feedb.notes: Hit gating is retained, but native miss feedback does not yet reproduce the Classic result path.

classic-monster-zero-melee-action-fallba.requiredEvidence: Classic zero-attack action-selection source and a combat fixture proving whether a native action floor is allowed.
classic-monster-zero-melee-action-fallba.notes: Remake currently supplies one melee action when the source record supplies none.

unresolved-classic-picture-resource.requiredEvidence: A licensed or user-owned Classic resource inventory containing the exact picture ID and a source record proving the intended display site.
unresolved-classic-picture-resource.notes: The picture remains unchanged when the optional external resource is absent.

unresolved-classic-sound-resource.requiredEvidence: A licensed or user-owned Classic sound inventory containing the exact sound ID and a source record proving playback and wait behavior.
unresolved-classic-sound-resource.notes: The action remains a silent no-op when the optional external resource is absent.
